source_policy: Official NOAA MRMS only. NCEP MRMS HTTPS is preferred for matching timestamps; NOAA NODD/AWS supplies fallback frames when needed. Published frames are real MRMS analyses sampled to nominal 10-minute slots; no temporal interpolation or averaging is performed.

winter_type.method: MRMS radar + HRRR 1-h forecast precipitation type

intensity.bin_rule: lower inclusive; 75+ uses final color; below 5 transparent

winter_type.fallback: MRMS rain/snow only where HRRR phase is unavailable or dry; no inferred transition band
